profile: Hawaiian Electric Industries is a Hawai‘i-based holding company centered on Hawaiian Electric, a regulated utility serving O‘ahu, Maui, Lāna‘i, Moloka‘i, and Hawai‘i Island. The utility generates or purchases electricity and operates transmission and distribution systems for households and businesses. HEI also retains a minority stake in American Savings Bank after selling most of its ownership and is completing its strategic exit from Pacific Current.
